originalTitle: Violent crypto attacks rise as criminals hunt bigger payouts
simplifiedContent: There has been a big increase in violent attacks on people who own cryptocurrency, with 33% more attacks happening in the first half of 2026 than before. These attacks have resulted in losses of $124 million, which is a lot of money. This is happening because criminals are using a combination of online tricks, persuasion, and physical force to steal people's digital assets. France has seen the most attacks, and it's becoming a major problem. This matters because it shows that owning cryptocurrency can come with significant risks, and investors should be aware of these dangers.

originalTitle: IDFC First Bank Q1 Results: Profit shoots up 132% YoY to record Rs 1,075 crore; NII jumps 21%
simplifiedContent: IDFC First Bank just announced its quarterly results, and its profit is the highest it's ever been at Rs 1,075 crore. This is a big increase of 132% compared to the same time last year, when the bank made a profit of Rs 463 crore. The bank's Net Interest Income (NII) also went up by 21%. This matters because it shows that the bank is doing well financially, which can be good news for people who have invested in the bank. The strong results could also affect the bank's stock price, which may be of interest to investors who own or are considering buying the bank's shares.

originalTitle: Govt of Singapore’s India portfolio: 7 stocks rally up to 135% in CY26
simplifiedContent: The Government of Singapore has investments in 39 Indian companies, and the total value of these investments decreased by 25% to Rs 1,51,353 crore in June 2026. Despite this overall decline, some of these companies performed well, with one company called Aditya Infotech seeing its value increase by 137%. However, other companies like HDFC Bank and Syngene International did not do as well, which brought down the overall performance of the portfolio. This news is important because it shows how the Government of Singapore's investments in Indian companies are performing. The performance of these investments can have an impact on the overall stock market and economy.

originalTitle: Metals Fluctuate as Middle East Escalation Keeps Bulls in Check
simplifiedContent: The prices of metals like copper and aluminum went up and down at the end of the week. This happened because there's a possibility of more conflict in the Middle East, which could cause problems for the global economy. As a result, investors who are optimistic about the market, known as "bulls", are being cautious and not buying as much. This means that the prices of metals are not increasing as much as they might have if investors were more confident. The uncertainty is keeping the market relatively stable, rather than letting it rise quickly.

originalTitle: Big Tech Debt Flood Is Taking Over Risk In Market: Credit Weekly
simplifiedContent: Some of the biggest technology companies are investing a lot of money in artificial intelligence (AI) and to do this, they are borrowing money by selling bonds. This is causing a large increase in bond sales, which is affecting the US corporate bond market. This means that these tech companies are taking on a lot of debt, which can be risky. The impact of this is significant and may be more far-reaching than people think. This trend is changing the way the bond market is working, which is worth paying attention to if you're interested in investments.

originalTitle: IDFC First Bank Q1 Results 2026: Net profit surges 132% to  ₹1,075 crore; NII rises 21%
simplifiedContent: IDFC First Bank just released its financial results for the first quarter of 2026, and they're really good. The bank's net profit (its total earnings) jumped 132% to ₹1,075 crore, which is a big increase. This happened because the bank made more money from interest on loans and had to set aside less money for potential losses. The bank also saw growth in its customer business, with more loans and deposits than the same time last year, which is a positive sign. Overall, these results suggest that the bank is doing well and growing its business.
